definitions.explanation: The physical release or spreading of heat, light, gas, or other substances into the surrounding area.
Releasing pent-up feelings, stress, or energy through some activity. Often used with ストレス (stress).

examples.japanese: {熱|ねつ}を{発散|はっさん}する
この{素材|そざい}は{水分|すいぶん}を{発散|はっさん}しやすい。
{太陽|たいよう}は{膨大|ぼうだい}なエネルギーを{発散|はっさん}している。
examples.english: The sun emits an enormous amount of energy.

examples.japanese: ストレス{発散|はっさん}
カラオケでストレスを{発散|はっさん}した。
{運動|うんどう}は{溜|た}まったエネルギーを{発散|はっさん}するのに{効果的|こうかてき}だ。
examples.english: Exercise is effective for releasing pent-up energy.

notes:
USAGE: Sense 2 (stress release) is very common in everyday speech, especially the phrase ストレス{発散|はっさん}. Sense 1 is more technical/scientific.

MATHEMATICS: In math, {発散|はっさん} also means 'divergence' (opposite of {収束|しゅうそく} 'convergence').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ストレス{発散|はっさん} (stress relief)
- {熱|ねつ}/{光|ひかり}/{エネルギー|えねるぎー}を{発散|はっさん}する (to emit heat/light/energy)
- {発散|はっさん}{方法|ほうほう} (way to let off steam)

RELATED WORDS:
- {放出|ほうしゅつ} (emission, discharge - more technical)
- {解消|かいしょう} (elimination, relief - for stress)
- {吐|は}き{出|だ}す (to let out, vent)
